notes: Only ready=true regional areas are included; future non-ready rooms are intentionally excluded.
All 25 original Vortex habitats are adaptations, numbered with the existing numeric map keys.
Kanto mappings use supplied verified map_music.csv; one Birth Island adaptation fills absent area music.
Johto canonical map headers come from supplied Crystal track_catalog.json; generic/custom rooms inherit locality.
Hoenn uses supplied named tracks, route families, and explicit cave/island adaptations where exact source music is unverified.
Unbound unknown/locality-only rooms are marked inherited or adaptation; no unsupported claim that generic room artwork identifies a gym.
Unbound day/night variants are provided only when explicitly named in the supplied track catalog; story dark/light variants are not guessed.
No remote files are required; every referenced source file is asserted present.
